metric: Percentage reporting high or moderately high (6–10/10) trust in national government
population: OECD-18 matched countries with data in all 2021, 2023 and 2025 waves
notes: These are OECD published UNWEIGHTED country means from weighted survey shares, with survey population differing each wave.
Three aggregate OECD cohort data points are not 18 individual country time series.
The panel is biennial, not annual, and cannot identify a feedback path or a full dynamic GMM model.
Do not combine these means with the 28-country 2023–2025 matched published-rounded extract; denominators differ.
The first collection for Brazil was April 2022, but Brazil is not in the OECD-18 matched member cohort.
